title: I built a site full of movement games for kids where you play using a webcam. It's completely free!
author: askdoobie
selftext:
[http://maxihop.com/](http://maxihop.com/)

**IMPORTANT: If you do not trust the site with your camera/video feed, you can open the site and then disconnect from the internet; it still works, just without music. Alternatively, you can ask an LLM to check the code to see if any data is sent to a server (it isn't).**

I made a site where kids can play games using their bodies as controllers!

I built it with Opus 5.5 and lots of testing. The fun part was that my kid could share ideas, and we could implement and test them really fast.

The video was also made with Opus 5.5, and the music was made with Gemini Lyria 3.

It's completely free!
